title: Implement core seeding utilities and configuration
description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- config.ts with all 30 table configurations (strategy, dependencies, GSI names)
- types.ts with TypeScript interfaces
- logger.ts with progress tracking utilities
- production-client.ts for connecting to source environment
- sandbox-client.ts helpers

## Implementation Steps
- Define TableConfig interface with strategy, dependencies, GSI metadata
- Create loadConfig() function returning complete table configuration
- Implement Logger class with phase(), table(), progress(), success(), warn(), error() methods
- Create createProductionClient() using Amplify.configure with API endpoint and key
- Add utility functions for data transformation

All core utilities are in place and ready for strategy implementation.
